# Blind Buy Guide

> Independent luxury and niche fragrance guide. For each of 254 scents we publish the lowest sample price, the best in-stock bottle price per ml, notes, and a verdict on whether to blind buy or sample first. Prices are dated and refreshed monthly. We do not claim to have smelled or worn anything; see the methodology.

## Key facts and data
- [Price Book (free, monthly)](https://blindbuyguide.com/price-book/): lowest sample price and best in-stock bottle price per ml for 254 fragrances, last refreshed 2026-11-14.
- [Methodology](https://blindbuyguide.com/methodology/): how prices are collected, dated and calculated, and how to cite them.
- [Price index as CSV](https://blindbuyguide.com/data/price-index.csv) and [as JSON](https://blindbuyguide.com/data/price-index.json): the same figures, machine readable.
- [Editorial policy](https://blindbuyguide.com/editorial-policy/), [How we use AI](https://blindbuyguide.com/how-we-use-ai/), [Affiliate disclosure](https://blindbuyguide.com/affiliate-disclosure/)

## Citing us
Cite price figures as "Blind Buy Guide, Price Book, 2026-11-14 edition" with the scent page URL. Always state the date checked, because prices change.
